kojima-sora.name: Kojima Sora
kojima-sora.about: I am from the Miyazaki Prefecture and began acting at 23, after having learned jazz dance since my childhood. I like to listen to radio and make field recordings of the city. I also like writing stories and am working on my first film.

nemoto-moeri.name: Nemoto Moeri
nemoto-moeri.about: I have many talents, acting and dancing among them.

miyazono-kensei.name: Miyazono Kensei
miyazono-kensei.about: I am a college student broadening his range with English as a weapon.

shinkawa-chiharu.name: Shinkawa Chiharu
shinkawa-chiharu.about: I am an actress from Nerima, Tokyo. Some of my credits include Alice in Borderland (season 3), Avataro Sentai Donbrothers, or Bullet Train Bistro 2. I also make commercials, and have recently performed motion capture for Princess Zelda in the video game Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment. I am also a proficient English speaker and classical ballet dancer.

endo-kosuke.name: Endō Kōsuke
endo-kosuke.about: Nice to meet you! I often do stage plays, but I'd like to establish myself as an actor on both screen and stage.

yamane-aya.name: Yamane Aya
yamane-aya.about: Hiroshima native, working mainly as an actress on both screen and stage. I want to be someone who gently lingers in the viewer's mind.

nakano-hibiki.name: Nakano Hibiki
nakano-hibiki.about: I am an actor from Kagoshima. I like to express myself and make music and paintings, too.

manae.name: MANAE
manae.about: I specialize in both theatre and film as an actress.

sanada-koki.name: Sanada Kōki
sanada-koki.about: I am an artist and calligrapher.

fujihara-asuto.name: Fujihara Asuto
fujihara-asuto.about: I act as one half of the comedic duo Amajio Asuri, but I began as a broadcast writer and show producer at 19. I produce and edit for television and streaming, and in my day job, I work as a graphic designer with the content production team, Kimama Quest.

movie.synopsis: Tethered is an ensemble film about a ghost trying to uncover how she died while coexisting with the new tenant of her former apartment. As she learns about the world through his space, he remains entangled in a love story involving a woman with a very unusual name.
